row.title: The published template must pass its own suites standalone: two kit tests read platform files, and two kit workflows skipped the filing gate
row.body: After the first template publish the seed repository failed its own tests. Causes in the core's kit: two Worker tests read deploy/ and site/ without being on the monorepo-only register, and improve.yml and redteam.yml committed docs/issues without the balance gate the kit's own balance check requires. The publish also holds back files that differ in the copy, so a half-updated template is possible; that drift is tracked as Q-FLEETMAP-seed. Fix: the platform-only assertions are their own registered tests, both workflows pass the gate, and a kit test fails any test that reads above the kit unregistered.
